title: MFA enrollment and login
preconditions: Fresh local environment; bootstrap admin exists; authenticator available
steps: Login with bootstrap credentials; enroll TOTP; enter current six-digit code; complete login
expected_result: User reaches authenticated application; MFA is enabled; subsequent login requires TOTP
evidence: Screenshot of successful authenticated page; tester note that secret is not captured

title: Critical role cannot bypass MFA
preconditions: Critical-role account has MFA enabled
steps: Login with correct username/password; do not provide TOTP; attempt to navigate directly to /dashboard
expected_result: Application does not establish a normal authenticated session before valid MFA completion
evidence: Screenshot of MFA challenge; no secret value in evidence

title: Create UAT organization structure
preconditions: Authenticated admin with organization manage permissions
steps: Create company; create branch; create department; create position; create project/cost center if available
expected_result: Organization records are created once and appear in lists for dependent UAT scenarios

title: Create active employee
preconditions: UAT company, department, position and employee type exist; personnel.create permission
steps: Open /personnel; select organization data; enter unique employee number, name and hire date; submit
expected_result: Employee is created as ACTIVE and user is redirected to Personel 360
evidence: Employee number and resulting Personel 360 screenshot

title: Required personnel field validation
preconditions: Personnel create permission
steps: Attempt employee creation without employee number; repeat without department/position/hire date
expected_result: Invalid employee is not created and required fields are enforced
evidence: Validation screenshot and attempted field set

title: Search and filter employees
preconditions: At least two employees with different department/status/type
steps: Search by employee number/name; filter by company, department, type, project and status
expected_result: Returned rows match active filters and pagination count is coherent
evidence: Filter values and result count screenshot

title: Personnel 360 sensitive data access boundary
preconditions: Employee exists; one user has sensitive-data permission and another does not
steps: Open same Personel 360 with privileged user; inspect sensitive section; repeat with restricted user
expected_result: Sensitive identity/IBAN values are only available through authorized path and are not exposed to restricted user
evidence: Two screenshots with values masked/redacted in evidence

title: Create work calendar
preconditions: UAT company exists; attendance.calendar.manage permission
steps: Select company; create calendar with unique code/name; mark default if desired
expected_result: Calendar appears in list and can be selected

title: Define calendar day
preconditions: Work calendar exists
steps: Select calendar; add a WORKDAY with planned minutes; add a HOLIDAY/OFF_DAY entry
expected_result: Special days appear with correct type, paid flag and planned minutes rules

title: Create day and overnight shifts
preconditions: UAT company exists; attendance.shift.manage permission
steps: Create normal shift such as 08:00-17:00; create overnight shift such as 20:00-08:00
expected_result: Normal shift has expected planned minutes; overnight shift is classified as crossing midnight
evidence: Shift rows and calculated planned minutes

title: Assign shift and calendar to employee
preconditions: Active employee, calendar and shift exist; attendance.assignment permission
steps: Select employee; assign shift/calendar with validFrom and optional validUntil
expected_result: Assignment is stored and listed for employee with effective dates

title: Ingest immutable raw PDKS events
preconditions: Employee has effective shift/calendar; attendance.raw.ingest permission
steps: Select employee/date; add IN and OUT events with unique external event IDs
expected_result: Both raw events appear with local date/time, direction, source and UTC offset; records are not editable from UI
evidence: Raw-event table screenshot and external IDs

title: Reject duplicate external PDKS event
preconditions: A raw event exists with an externalEventId
steps: Submit another event using the same integration identity/external event ID
expected_result: Duplicate does not create an unintended second business event; error/idempotent behavior is explicit

title: Calculate normal daily attendance
preconditions: Valid IN/OUT events and shift/calendar assignment exist
steps: Select employee/date; click Günlük Puantajı Hesapla
expected_result: Daily row shows planned/worked/leave/late/early/overtime candidate values and non-error processing status

title: Incomplete punches require review
preconditions: Employee has shift/calendar; only an IN or malformed event set exists
steps: Calculate daily attendance
expected_result: Result is not silently accepted; processingStatus becomes REVIEW_REQUIRED or equivalent with explanation

title: Create overtime request from candidate
preconditions: Daily attendance has overtimeCandidateMinutes > 0; request permission
steps: Select employee; choose candidate; request a positive minute amount not greater than candidate; add reason
expected_result: Request is created in PENDING_MANAGER and source daily version is recorded

title: Reject overtime above candidate
preconditions: Daily row has known overtime candidate
steps: Attempt to request more minutes than candidate or zero minutes
expected_result: UI/API rejects invalid requested minutes and no request is created
evidence: Validation message and unchanged request count

title: Manager then HR approval chain
preconditions: Request exists in PENDING_MANAGER; manager and HR approver roles available
steps: Manager approves; verify PENDING_HR; HR approves with final minutes <= requested
expected_result: Request transitions PENDING_MANAGER → PENDING_HR → APPROVED and approvedMinutes is final value
evidence: Status screenshots from both approval steps

title: Reject overtime request
preconditions: Pending overtime request exists
steps: Reject at permitted approval step and enter reason
expected_result: Request becomes REJECTED and cannot proceed as approved overtime
evidence: Rejected row and decision note screenshot

title: Create date-effective meal rate
preconditions: Camp and meal type exist; meal.rate.manage permission
steps: Select camp and meal type; create rate with validFrom, unit price and currency
expected_result: Rate appears with correct effective interval and currency

title: Record meal consumption with cost snapshot
preconditions: Active employee, camp, meal type and effective rate exist
steps: Record quantity 1 for selected date/source
expected_result: Consumption is created; unitPriceSnapshot and totalCostSnapshot equal rate × quantity

title: Historical meal cost remains stable after rate change
preconditions: MEAL-002 consumption exists
steps: Create a later or replacement effective rate; reload historical consumption
expected_result: Existing consumption keeps original unit-price and total-cost snapshot

title: Create camp room and bed hierarchy
preconditions: UAT company ID known; camp.site.manage permission
steps: Create camp; select camp; create room; select room; create bed
expected_result: Camp → room → bed hierarchy is selectable and unique codes are retained

title: Create date-effective accommodation rate
preconditions: Camp exists; camp.rate.manage permission
steps: Select camp; create nightly rate with validFrom and currency
expected_result: Rate appears for selected camp and effective interval

title: Open and close employee stay
preconditions: Active employee, bed and effective camp rate exist
steps: Create stay with check-in; verify ACTIVE; close with exclusive checkout date
expected_result: Stay closes with correct night count and final cost snapshot = nights × nightly rate
evidence: Active and closed stay screenshots plus calculation

title: Prevent overlapping bed occupancy
preconditions: An active/overlapping stay already occupies a bed
steps: Attempt second stay on same bed with overlapping date range
expected_result: Database/application rejects overlapping allocation; existing stay remains unchanged
evidence: Error message and unchanged stay list

title: Create effective compensation
preconditions: Active employee exists; payroll.compensation.manage permission
steps: Select employee; add salary starting on first day of month; set currency and overtime multiplier
expected_result: Compensation appears in history with correct effective interval
evidence: Compensation row screenshot with sensitive amount redacted if evidence leaves UAT workspace

title: Reject invalid compensation effective date
preconditions: Employee exists
steps: Attempt compensation validFrom that is not first day of month; attempt zero salary/out-of-range multiplier
expected_result: Invalid compensation is rejected and no bad history row is created

title: Payroll lifecycle calculation
preconditions: Employee has compensation; attendance/leave/overtime/meal/camp data prepared for period
steps: Create period; open; calculate; move to review; approve; close
expected_result: Status transitions DRAFT → OPEN → CALCULATED → UNDER_REVIEW → APPROVED → CLOSED
evidence: Screenshot/evidence for each status and selected result totals

title: Closed payroll period is immutable
preconditions: A payroll period is CLOSED
steps: Attempt lifecycle/data change against closed period; create correction/revision instead
expected_result: Closed period cannot be mutated; correction path uses a new revision

title: Payroll result includes approved overtime and employer costs
preconditions: Prepared employee has known planned/worked/leave minutes, approved overtime, meal and camp costs
steps: Calculate period; inspect employee result
expected_result: Approved overtime minutes and meal/accommodation employer costs match prepared source data; pay-before-statutory values are internally coherent
evidence: Manual reconciliation worksheet/reference values and result screenshot

title: Create stock location item and receipt
preconditions: UAT company exists; stock manage/movement permissions
steps: Create stock location; create item with minimum level; record RECEIPT quantity
expected_result: Balance equals receipt quantity and movement appears in append-only ledger

title: Issue and return stock movement
preconditions: Stock balance exists; active employee exists
steps: Record ISSUE linked to employee; record RETURN
expected_result: Signed movements adjust balance correctly and employee linkage is visible

title: Create and assign asset to employee
preconditions: Active employee exists; asset manage/assign permissions
steps: Create asset card; select available asset; assign to employee with assigned date
expected_result: Asset status/assignment indicates employee is current custodian and item is no longer available for duplicate assignment

title: Return or mark assigned asset lost
preconditions: Assigned asset exists
steps: Return asset normally; separately test damaged return or lost flow on another asset
expected_result: Normal return restores expected availability; damaged return enters maintenance state; lost flow enters lost state; assignment closes
evidence: Final asset statuses and assignment history

title: Create request type and SLA
preconditions: UAT company exists; workflow.request_type.manage permission
steps: Create active request type with SLA minutes and requiredFieldsJson
expected_result: Type appears with code/name/SLA/required fields

title: Configure multi-step approval flow
preconditions: Request type exists; approver user/role IDs known
steps: Add ordered USER/ROLE approval steps and save
expected_result: Active step list is persisted in exact order; type version increments as designed

title: Submit request and preserve approval snapshot
preconditions: Request type and approval flow exist
steps: Create draft request; submit; then alter request-type approval flow as admin; reopen submitted request
expected_result: Submitted request keeps original approval snapshot and is not retroactively changed
evidence: Submitted request approvals before/after type edit

title: Approve request through all steps
preconditions: Submitted request has at least two approval steps
steps: First approver approves; second approver approves
expected_result: Current step advances in order; final request becomes APPROVED/RESOLVED according to workflow model; timeline records each action

title: Reject request and retain audit timeline
preconditions: Submitted request pending approver
steps: Reject with explanatory note
expected_result: Request transitions to rejection terminal state; note and actor/time appear in timeline

title: Process SLA threshold events
preconditions: Request with short SLA is due/overdue; workflow.sla.process permission
steps: Run SLA processing; reload events
expected_result: Expected SLA event is emitted once with severity/message and request identity

title: Restricted user cannot access admin actions
preconditions: User has view-only subset of permissions and valid company scope
steps: Open module routes; attempt create/manage/approve operations where controls are absent or API would deny
expected_result: Unauthorized controls are not rendered and direct API attempts are denied; view access remains within granted scope
evidence: Screenshots plus HTTP status for one direct denied call

title: Company scope prevents cross-company data access
preconditions: Two companies exist; user scoped to only one
steps: List/search employees and dependent business records; attempt direct request using other company ID
expected_result: Only scoped company data is returned; cross-company operation is denied/not found according to contract
evidence: Result lists and one denied cross-company request

title: Employee month from attendance to payroll
preconditions: UAT organization and reference data exist
steps: Create employee; assign shift/calendar; ingest punches; calculate attendance; approve overtime; record meals; create/close camp stay; set compensation; calculate payroll
expected_result: Payroll result traces prepared attendance/overtime/meal/camp inputs without unexplained variance
evidence: Scenario IDs used, prepared source totals and payroll result reconciliation

title: Employee exit and asset/camp closure
preconditions: Employee has active asset assignment and camp stay
steps: Perform required asset return and camp checkout; terminate employee through Personel 360
expected_result: No active operational assignment remains after exit; historical records remain visible/auditable
evidence: Employee status plus closed asset/stay evidence
